_default.note: Used where a country value is missing; documented as an app assumption

DE.note: Hot water 12.5 kWh/(m2.a) per A_N: GModG § 20 Abs. 2. Internal gains 45 Wh/(m2.d) = 1.875 W/m2: DIN V 18599-10 single-family (paid standard; secondary)

IE.note: DEAP 4.2.7: 21 C living area / 18 C rest, 56 h/week; occupancy N(TFA) formula official. Gains and hot water depend on N inside the DEAP software; the app keeps its EN default

DK.note: SBi 213 dwelling defaults: persons 1.5 W/m2 + equipment incl. lighting 3.5 W/m2 (min 90 / 210 W per home), hot water 250 L/(m2.a). SBi 213 itself is paid; values from the industry guide

FI.note: Decree 1010/2017 class 1 (small residential): §10 outdoor air 0.4 dm3/(s.m2), heating limit 21 C; §11 lighting 6 / appliances 3 / people 2 W/m2 with usage 0.1 / 0.6 / 0.6; §12 hot water 35 kWh/(m2.a), at most 4200 kWh per dwelling

BE-BRU.note: Brussels certificate: 18 C mean in all rooms, 365 days; hot water scales with home size (about 150 L/day for 170 m2)
